meta.note: statScoreNow/Long = 100*Phi(z), z vs the position starter pool (top N by the same metric; N: {"QB":12,"RB":24,"WR":36,"TE":12}). 50 = average starter. statScoreLong uses longPPG = availability * sum_k discount^(k-1) * expPPG_k, expPPG_k = survival_k*PPGnoCliff_k + (1-survival_k)*0.5*PPGnoCliff_k; survival_k = prod(1 - cliffHazard), hazard = Harstad table blended with a nflverse logistic fit (see docs/stats-model.md).
